name: gainsight-mcp-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins pairing the Staircase AI MCP and the Gainsight CS MCP for Customer Success teams.

plugins.name: staircase
plugins.description: Staircase AI account intelligence for Claude. Book triage, account deep dive, meeting prep, risk check, follow-up draft, account handoff, renewal watchlist, risk radar, expansion scout, churn review, voice of customer, team manager, and manager 1:1 prep, built report-first on the Staircase MCP with evidence behind every call-out. Resolves your book automatically on first use. Read-only. Needs only the Staircase AI connector.

plugins.name: gainsight-cs
plugins.description: Customer Success operations plugin pairing the Staircase AI MCP (communication intelligence) with the Gainsight CS MCP (CRM state + write paths). 13 core skills + 4 experimental, organized as foundation (MCP expertise + role-adaptive onboarding) + IC workflows (book pulse, account workspace, meeting processor, handoff, stakeholder outreach, EBR scheduling) + exec workflows (renewal radar, churn retrospective, pattern hunter, renewal priority planner). Cowork-first design with approval gates on every customer-facing write.

plugins.name: fun-lifeskills
plugins.description: Personality-driven life skills for outside-of-work routines. Ships Chef Gordon — a profane, brilliant kitchen tyrant in the spirit of Gordon Ramsay mid-service who walks you through real cooking via targeted verbal abuse and saves the recipes you actually liked. Includes both a Claude Code/Cowork skill (file-based recipe storage) and a copy-paste system prompt for Claude Projects (so it works on your phone while you cook).
